figurative_meaning_en: Many people gathering together to eat
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামে বছরান্তে সবাই মিলে ভোজ করে।
example_sentences_in_english: In the village, everyone gathers for a feast at the end of the year.
A communal feast has been arranged for the family ceremony.
note: Refers to a traditional communal meal in Bengali culture
